mapper.select: select id, dept_id as deptId, subject_node_id as subjectNodeId, energy_allocation as energyAllocation, enabled from report_dept_subject where dept_id = #{deptId}

select d.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, s.subject_node_id as subjectNodeId, n.name as subjectName, s.energy_allocation as energyAllocation, s.enabled from sys_dept d left join report_dept_subject s on s.dept_id = d.dept_id left join emission_node n on n.id = s.subject_node_id where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_id = #{deptId} ${params.dataScope} order by d.order_num, d.dept_id

select d.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, s.subject_node_id as subjectNodeId, n.name as subjectName, s.energy_allocation as energyAllocation, s.enabled from sys_carbon_company c inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = c.dept_id left join report_dept_subject s on s.dept_id = d.dept_id left join emission_node n on n.id = s.subject_node_id where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_id = #{deptId} ${params.dataScope} order by d.order_num, d.dept_id

select n.id as subjectNodeId, n.name as subjectName, t.id as templateId, t.name as templateName, t.dept_id as deptId from emission_node n inner join emission_template t on t.id = n.template_id where n.type_id in (1, 2) ${params.dataScope} union select n.id as subjectNodeId, n.name as subjectName, null as templateId, '已配置主体' as templateName, s.dept_id as deptId from report_dept_subject s inner join emission_node n on n.id = s.subject_node_id inner join sys_dept t on t.dept_id = s.dept_id where n.type_id in (1, 2) and t.status = '0' and t.del_flag = '0' and not exists (select 1 from emission_template old_template where old_template.id = n.template_id) ${params.dataScope} order by templateId, subjectNodeId
mapper.insert: insert into report_dept_subject (dept_id, subject_node_id, energy_allocation, enabled, create_by, create_time) values (#{deptId}, #{subjectNodeId}, #{energyAllocation}, '1', #{createBy}, now()) on duplicate key update subject_node_id = values(subject_node_id), energy_allocation = values(energy_allocation), enabled = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now()
